query: UPDATE device_pairing_requests r SET confirm_code = $3 FROM device_node_keys k JOIN paired_devices d ON d.id = k.paired_device_id WHERE k.node_id = $1 AND k.tenant_id = $2 AND k.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.paired_device_id = d.id AND r.node_id = k.node_id AND r.status = 'claimed' RETURNING r.id
